summary: In December 2019, one person was accused of the aggravated penetrative assault on a child in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu. The charges also include house trespass and criminal intimidation. A weapon was used or a threat was made. The accused is recorded as a repeat offender. Bail was granted. The accused was convicted and sentenced to 20 years in prison. An appeal against the verdict has been filed. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Aggravated penetrative assault on a child — Thoothukudi (2019) — appeal pending

summary: In January 2019, one person was arrested in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu for the aggravated penetrative assault on a child. The charges also include kidnapping, abduction and criminal intimidation. A weapon was used or a threat was made. Police have filed a chargesheet. The accused was convicted. An appeal against the verdict has been filed. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Aggravated penetrative assault on a child — Thoothukudi (2019) — convicted
